title: AdvancedIF: Rubric-Based Benchmarking and Reinforcement Learning for Advancing LLM Instruction Following
authors_zh: Yun He, Wenzhe Li, Hejia Zhang, Songlin Li, Karishma Mandyam 等
paper_type_zh: 高级指令跟随的专家 rubric 与奖励学习基准
best_for_zh: 需要训练或评估指令跟随 Judge、奖励模型和 RL 系统的研究者。
one_line: AdvancedIF uses human-written rubrics to evaluate and train complex, multi-turn, and system-level instruction following.
AdvancedIF 将专家 rubric 用于复杂、多轮和系统提示指令跟随的评测与强化学习。
why: It turns hard-to-verify instruction following into interpretable criterion-level rewards.
inclusion_reason: AdvancedIF combines human rubrics with training-ready verifier supervision for instruction following.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing instruction-following benchmarks mostly check formats or keywords and poorly cover priorities, exceptions, and semantic constraints in complex, multi-turn, and system prompts. They also lack interpretable training rewards, allowing models to satisfy surface form while violating intent.

AdvancedIF builds a difficult expert-rubric benchmark and introduces RIFL, combining rubric generation, a specialised verifier, and reward shaping so the same criteria support evaluation and reinforcement learning.

现有指令跟随基准多检查格式或关键词，难以覆盖复杂、多轮和系统提示中的优先级、例外与语义约束；这些任务也缺少可解释训练奖励，模型可能满足表面形式却违反真实意图。

AdvancedIF 用专家逐项 rubric 构建高难指令基准，并以 rubric 生成、专门 verifier 和奖励塑形组成 RIFL，使同一准则既能评测也能提供强化学习信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The ACL release contains more than 1,600 complex prompts spanning single-turn, multi-turn, and system-level constraints, each paired with expert atomic rubrics and an open evaluation script. The paper trains a rubric verifier and shapes criterion compliance into RL rewards. The data contribution is an interpretable instruction–criterion benchmark, while RIFL converts evaluation labels into training feedback.
ACL 正式版含 1,600 余个复杂指令提示，覆盖单轮、多轮和系统级约束，每题配专家原子 rubric 与公开评测脚本。论文进一步用这些对象训练 rubric verifier，并将逐条满足度塑造成 RL 奖励。数据贡献是可解释的指令—准则评测集，RIFL 则展示 rubric 可从评测标签转化为训练反馈。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Design instructions: Experts write tasks with multiple semantic constraints, dialogue history, and system priorities.
  1. Annotate rubrics: Required behaviours and prohibitions are decomposed into atomic criteria and reviewed.
  1. Train verifier: A model is fine-tuned on response–rubric–compliance labels for criterion-level feedback.
  1. Run RIFL: Verifier scores shape RL rewards; base model, rubric generator, weights, and budget must be fixed.

1. 设计指令： 专家编写包含多项语义约束、对话历史和系统优先级的任务。
  1. 标注 rubric： 将必要行为和禁忌拆为原子条目，并复核可判定性和覆盖度。
  1. 训练 verifier： 使用回答—rubric—满足标签微调模型，使其逐条给出反馈。
  1. 执行 RIFL： 以 verifier 得分塑形 RL 奖励；复现需固定基础模型、rubric 生成器、权重和预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html: RIFL produces a 6.7-point absolute gain on AdvancedIF and remains strong on public instruction-following benchmarks. Ablations show contributions from rubric generation, the verifier, and reward shaping. This supports rubrics as evaluation and training signals, although gains combine data, verifier, and RL effects and cannot be attributed to one component.
RIFL 在 AdvancedIF 上带来 6.7 个百分点的绝对提升，并在公开指令跟随基准上保持较强结果；消融显示 rubric 生成、专门 verifier 和奖励塑形均有贡献。这支持准则既能评估又能训练复杂指令能力，但提升包含数据、verifier 和 RL 的共同作用，不能全部归因于一个组件。

title: Novelty
新意
html: IFEval-style work relies on surface constraints and other RL methods often use holistic rewards. AdvancedIF covers semantic, multi-turn, and system instructions with expert atomic criteria and trains a criterion-level verifier for dense rewards. The novelty is connecting benchmark, judge, and training through rubrics, not the first use of RL.
IFEval 类工作依赖可程序检查的表面约束，其他 RL 方法常使用整体奖励。AdvancedIF 以专家原子准则覆盖语义、多轮和系统指令，并训练逐准则 verifier 形成稠密奖励。新意不是首次使用 RL，而是用 rubric 贯通 benchmark、Judge 和训练。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Expert criteria may not cover every valid response path, and excessive decomposition can reward checklist answers.
  1. Limitation 2: A flawed verifier can make policies optimise the judge rather than the instruction.
  1. Limitation 3: Public prompts may enter training corpora and require contamination checks.

1. 局限1： 专家准则可能无法覆盖所有合理回答路径，过细拆分会奖励机械作答。
  1. 局限2： verifier 若有漏洞，策略会优化 Judge 而非真实指令。
  1. 局限3： 公开提示可能进入训练语料，后续需污染检查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Evaluate complex, multi-turn, and system prompts separately with criterion failures.
  1. Use case 2: Reuse RIFL for non-programmable rubric rewards after adversarial verifier testing.
  1. Use case 3: Prefer programmatic verifiers for deterministically checkable constraints.

1. 使用场景1： 按复杂、多轮和系统提示分别评测模型并输出逐准则失败。
  1. 使用场景2： 复用 RIFL 将不可程序验证指令转成 rubric reward，训练前测对抗鲁棒性。
  1. 使用场景3： 可确定检查的约束应优先使用程序 verifier。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Use expert rubrics to evaluate and train advanced instruction following.
  2. Method: Difficult prompts, atomic criteria, a fine-tuned verifier, and rubric-shaped RL.
  3. Data: More than 1,600 prompts, expert rubrics, and evaluation scripts.
  4. Evidence: RIFL gains 6.7 points, with positive component ablations.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for semantic-constraint RL; audit reward hacking first.

1. 一句话定位： 用专家 rubric 评测并训练复杂指令跟随。
  2. 方法抓手： 高难提示、原子准则、微调 verifier 和 rubric-shaped RL。
  3. 数据抓手： 1,600+ 提示、专家 rubric 和评测脚本。
  4. 证据锚点： RIFL 绝对提升 6.7 点，组件消融均有效。
  5. 复用决定： 适合语义约束 RL；先审计奖励投机。
